changes.title: Packs phase1
items: Pack combat (still on the pause page's switch) now covers the next eleven animals too: wolves howl and strike together, boars charge in a line, bats' screech turns your steering, ravens leave dark images of the flock that soak up your 💌s, herons blink in where you blink, toads leap in on a spore cloud, and more

changes.title: Pack combat
items: Try pack combat: switch it on from the pause page, and home's ten kinds fight in packs, glowing together before each combo, one lunging while the others fire and one throws its kind's special move, then falling back before they come again

changes.title: Followers ground
items: Animals following you weigh you down: an adult's worth (one adult, or three young; lighter and heavier kinds count for less or more) and you can't take off. Try anyway and you lift a little, then your leashes snap taut and pull you back down; while they're that heavy, their leashes show it. Put their sigils down to fly again
